fields.subject: Request: manual chlorine feed at Pump Station 3 and second field crew
fields.message:
At 1405 the HMI at Pump Station 3 showed the sodium hypochlorite feed setpoint changed from 1.8 to 0.0 mg/L. Nobody on shift made the change. Field crew (Unit W-12) confirms free chlorine residual at the PS-3 discharge is 0.2 mg/L and falling.

Request approval to:
1. Take PS-3 chemical feed off SCADA and run it in local/manual.
2. Send a second crew with a portable analyzer to sample at Hillcrest Reservoir and the Elm St. tank.
3. Notify the State Drinking Water Program duty officer if residual drops below 0.2 mg/L at any entry point.

IT has isolated the plant HMI workstation from the business network. Do not reboot it; forensics needed.
fields.reply: Approved items 1 and 2. Hold item 3 until the 1500 sample results are in. PIO to draft a precautionary notice in case we need it.
